column3: With respect to the BioMed MIT Portfolio Mortgage Loan (8.3%), the portfolio is comprised of eight mixed-use properties totaling 1,314,481 square feet. Across the portfolio, 1,260,760 square feet (approximately 95.9% of total net rentable area) is used for life science laboratory space, 53,221 square feet (approximately 4.0% of total net rentable area) is used for office space, and 500 square feet (approximately 0.0% of total net rentable area) is used for storage space. In addition, the 65 Landsdowne Mortgaged Property includes a standalone parking garage located across the street from the main portion of the Mortgaged Property, and the related parking revenue thereon represents a significantly higher portion of the 65 Landsdowne Mortgaged Property’s total revenue, ranging from approximately 36.4% in 2022 to 42.0% in 2024, than the 8.7% of underwritten total revenue for the entire portfolio.
